title: DAL Function Specification
description: Schema for specifying a Prisma Data Access Layer function to be implemented by Agente04_DevBackend. All DB access goes through DAL functions — never direct prisma calls in features/ or route handlers.

function_name.description: Name of the function within the DAL object.

file_path.description: File path for this DAL. Must follow the pattern lib/db/[model].dal.ts.

prisma_model.description: The Prisma model name (matches the model name in schema.prisma, PascalCase).

operation.description: The Prisma operation type used by this function.

input_type.description: TypeScript type for the function's input parameter.

uses_select.description: Whether this function uses Prisma select to return a subset of fields.

uses_include.description: Whether this function uses Prisma include to load related records.

uses_raw_sql.description: Whether this function uses $queryRaw or $executeRaw. Must be false — no raw SQL in DAL functions.
